blind: No R27 independent holdout opened. Can only run if same protect/gain policy passes including previous held-out negatives. If stronger stocks fail, keep failure and do not tune threshold.
classification: separate successor after disclosed single-stream counterexample; new independent outcomes remain unknown; no change to the submitted or first prototype versions

prepositive_amendment.cause: First normal-only attempt found no event25 attribute and stopped without a model or any candidate forced outcomes. Frozen C3 actually integrates the same NormalForce in witness; its normal inactive-alarms skip Jacobian projection.
prepositive_amendment.interface: Read witness.residual/midpos/bias only, use private published Nominal payload scratch to project via the same full-rank Jacobian as NormalForce. No extra dynamics integration or mutation of the parent detector.
prepositive_amendment.settling_clarification: As aggregate two-channel and individual bounds are not equal, checking only the latter could notify on the next still-rising sample. Require BOTH increments to be closer to zero than to their own measured peak, in addition to returning within individual normal bounds. A physical plateau, not a debounce or a target-timed delay.

reason: Single residual threshold crossing in isolation can mean ordinary drift; holding that crossing high starts too early when the native detector later recognizes the same event. Use corroboration plus plateau completion, not a time/mass-specific inhibition.
runtime: C3-only public nominals and 2 sensor-derived estimates already computed in event25. Need leading displacement in same world direction beyond joint normal envelope, then both rates decline inside individual normal envelopes while both levels nearer measured peak than preceding baseline. Native alert in estimation window or acquisition prevents a new duplicate, never suppresses native. Optional message uses the original normal models 4-sample decision width; distinct event telemetry carries physical ownership. No programmed force, reference twin, classifier time windows, hardware or cell identity.
training: Same 27 genuine non-collision traces, not failed normal-audit cases. Eight fixed signed directions, each normal-only max-plus-mechanics-spread envelope, new joint statistic minimum signed response across the already available independent momentum-residual and delayed inverse-force observer. No further fitted thresholds.
